children.text: 只想发出警告，指出情况偏离了正轨，可使用模块

content.code:
>>> from warnings import warn
>>> warn("I've got a bad feeling about this.")
__main__:1: UserWarning: I've got a bad feeling about this.
>>>

children.text: 警告只显示一次。如果再次运行最后一行代码，什么事情都不会发生。
其他代码在使用你的模块，可使用模块
来抑制你发出的警告，并指定要采取的措施，如

content.code:
>>> from warnings import filterwarnings
>>> filterwarnings("ignore")
>>> warn("Anyone out there?")
>>> filterwarnings("error")
>>> warn("Something is very wrong!")
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<stdin>", line 1, in <module>
UserWarning: Something is very wrong!

children.text: 如果将警告转换为错误，将使用你指定的异常。
另外，还可根据异常来过滤掉特定类型的警告

content.code:
>>> filterwarnings("error")
>>> warn("This function is really old...", DeprecationWarning)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<stdin>", line 1, in <module>
DeprecationWarning: This function is really old...
>>> filterwarnings("ignore", category=DeprecationWarning)
>>> warn("Another deprecation warning.", DeprecationWarning)
>>> warn("Something else.")
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<stdin>", line 1, in <module>
UserWarning: Something else.
